text:
mike: FYI saw a tail p95 spike this morning on host for tiny requests. pprof shows host-side parse/tokenize and the streaming write path are hot (tokenize_short -> frame_pack -> grpc_writev -> sys_writev).

mike: flame link: https://perf.internal/pprof?run=3412349999 (sampled stacks). stack snippet:
```
tokenize_short_input
  parse_headers
    frame_packer
      grpc_writev
        sys_writev
```

olga: does this line up with the kernel-affinity tweak we pushed yesterday that routes sub-128 token seqs to the micro kernels?

peter: I reproduced locally with `shortflow_replay --seq=40 --rps=700`. Observed throughput down ~10% and KV shard eviction bounce.

peter: quick numbers from local run:
```
batch_floor=4 -> p95=47ms, kv_evictions/s=195, writev_calls/s=840
batch_floor=14 -> p95=28ms, kv_evictions/s=22, writev_calls/s=210
```

sara: those metrics point to two interacting issues: tiny batches causing KV shard hotness, and fragmented HTTP/2 frames creating many writev syscalls. Micro kernels may not be running the frame_packer optimization.

mike: mitigation proposal: small canary that (1) raises short-seq batch_floor to 8, (2) turns on proxy frame_packer_coalesce for payloads <256B, and (3) add a kernel_selector fallback preference for kernels with lower syscall footprints.

deploy-bot: @mike scheduled canary deploy: service=host-ingress group=shortflow-mitigations percent=5

olga: add telemetry before rollout: per-shard kv_eviction_rate, batch_size_histogram, grpc_writev_count, parse_to_coalesce_ms. Also inject trace-id header so we can join pprof to metrics.

peter: I'll add a microspan covering tokenize->frame_pack and emit parse_coalesce_ms and batch_reason tag. ETA 40m.

sara: I'll flip the frame_packer_coalesce flag on canary and ensure the proxy writes are merged into single writev where possible. ETA deploy.

olga: please also log kernel_selection_reason so we can see whether traffic actually hits micro kernels after selector change.

mike: long-term idea: adaptive batch_floor that watches kv_eviction_rate and writev_call_rate, and inflates the floor if either metric exceeds thresholds. Also teach kernel selector to score syscall_count and memory-touch to avoid kernels that increase syscall storm for short sequences.

peter: action items:
- peter: instrument parse_coalesce_ms + batch_reason logs (ETA 40m)
- olga: add dashboards + trace header + log kernel_selection_reason (ETA 25m)
- sara: enable frame_packer_coalesce on canary (ETA deploy)
- mike: monitor canary p95/throughput & kv metrics and report back

mike: I'll watch the canary and post results in this thread. Call out immediately if errors, p99 or CPU climb. :eyes:
